title: Three Young Girls on Log Bench, Shaded Park - Vintage 1950s B&W Snapshot Photo
description: A square black-and-white snapshot featuring deckled edges, capturing three young girls sitting together on a massive, debarked log serving as a park bench. Shaded beneath mature trees, the girls are dressed in classic mid-1950s casual attire: the older girls wear rolled-up denim or dark pedal pushers with casual white tops, while the youngest sits in the middle wearing a patterned one-piece jumper or overalls with white socks and dark shoes. The reverse features a faint processing stamp reading '730 A'.
